title: rosa obtusifolia var. stantiensis
intro: Rosa obtusifolia var. stantiensis, commonly known as the Chinese rose or Tibetan rose, is a species of rose that is native to the Tibetan Plateau and parts of China. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat a range of health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa obtusifolia var. stantiensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
